title: KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation
title_zh: KernelZero: 协同进化的提案者和编码器用于持续改进 GPU 内核生成

paragraphs.en: High-performance GPU kernels are essential to modern machine learning systems, yet automatically generating kernels that are both correct and efficient remains challenging. Existing LLM-based approaches face two major limitations: the scarcity of high-quality training data aligned with the model’s current capabilities, and the inherent trade-off between kernel correctness and performance. To address these challenges, we propose KernelZero , a co-evolution framework that continuously improves GPU kernel generation through two specialized models: a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates them into CUDA or Triton kernels. KernelZero uses a frontier-driven module generation mechanism to continuously produce capability-aligned training modules based on the Coder’s current weaknesses. It further introduces Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO), which optimizes performance only after correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. By alternating the optimization of the Proposer and Coder, KernelZero forms an automatic curriculum that enables targeted and training-efficient capability improvement. Empirically, KernelZero-7B surpasses Claude-4.5-Sonnet on CUDA and DeepSeek-V4-Pro on Triton. On KernelBench Level 1 and 2, it achieves CUDA pass@1 scores of 75.8 % 75.8\% and 69.6 % 69.6\% , respectively, with pass@10 reaching 100 % 100\% and 97 % 97\% . On Triton, it achieves pass@1 scores of 77.2 % 77.2\% and 72.5 % 72.5\% , respectively.

paragraphs.en: Despite existing progress, training LLMs for GPU kernel generation faces two fundamental challenges. First, high-quality data that is aligned with and sensitive to the model’s current capabilities is scarce. As a result, training either fails to converge or incurs extremely high costs. Second, there exists a clear trade-off between correctness and performance. Optimizing solely for correctness often leads to conservative kernels with limited speedups, while aggressive performance optimizations significantly increase the risk of incorrect results. These challenges make it difficult to design a training paradigm that is both cost-effective and capable of improving GPU kernel generation correctness and performance.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有进展，但为 GPU 内核生成训练大型语言模型（LLM）仍面临两个根本性挑战。 首先，与模型当前能力相匹配且能反映其能力变化的优质数据十分稀缺。 因此，训练过程要么无法收敛，要么会产生极高的成本。 其次，正确性与性能之间存在明显的权衡关系。 仅针对正确性进行优化往往会生成保守的内核，导致加速效果有限；而激进的性能优化则会显著增加结果错误的风险。 这些挑战使得设计一种既经济高效、又能提升 GPU 内核生成正确性与性能的训练范式变得十分困难。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we propose KernelZero , a co-evolving framework that enables the continuous advancement of GPU kernel generation with two specialized models. Our insight is that a continuous training paradigm enables the model to dynamically identify and learn from the most capability-aligned samples at each iteration, thereby allowing more targeted and efficient improvement. KernelZero consists of a Proposer that generates Torch modules from API sets and a Coder that translates these modules into CUDA or Triton kernels, as shown in Figure 1 . To address the lack of capability-aligned data, we introduce a frontier-driven module generation mechanism that adaptively aligns the modules generated by the Proposer with the Coder’s current capabilities. Specifically, the mechanism extracts API sets from modules that the Coder fails to solve at each iteration to construct targeted inputs for the Proposer, while correctness-based feedback guides the Proposer to generate modules near the Coder’s capability frontier, avoiding modules that are either trivial or overly difficult. This module generation mechanism produces a continuous stream of high-quality, adaptive training data without manual annotation. To resolve the trade-off between correctness and performance, we propose Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO) for Coder training. This method separates correctness and performance signals through a group-level gating mechanism, ensuring that performance optimization is activated only when correctness becomes sufficiently reliable. The Proposer and the Coder are updated in turn using their respective rewards. This co-evolution process forms an automatic curriculum that continuously expands the model’s ability to generate kernels with higher correctness and performance while requiring fewer training steps.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 KernelZero——一个协同进化的框架，它通过两个专用模型实现了 GPU 内核生成的持续进步。 我们的核心观点是：连续训练范式使模型能够在每次迭代中动态识别并学习那些与当前能力最匹配的样本，从而实现更具针对性、更高效的改进。 KernelZero 由一个“提议器”和一个“编码器”组成：前者从 API 集合中生成 Torch 模块，后者将这些模块转换为 CUDA 或 Triton 内核，如图 1 所示。 为了解决缺乏与能力匹配的数据这一问题，我们引入了一种前沿驱动式的模块生成机制，该机制能自适应地将“提议器”生成的模块与“编码器”当前的能力对齐。 具体而言，该机制会在每次迭代中从“编码器”未能解决的模块中提取 API 集合，以此构建“提议器”的针对性输入；同时，基于正确性的反馈会引导“提议器”生成接近“编码器”能力边界的模块，避免生成过于简单或难度过高的模块。 这种模块生成机制无需人工标注，即可持续产出高质量且自适应的训练数据流。 为了解决正确性与性能之间的权衡问题，我们为“编码器”的训练提出了“正确性感知群体相对策略优化”（CA-GRPO）方法。 该方法通过群体级别的门控机制将正确性与性能信号分离，确保只有在正确性足够可靠时才会激活性能优化过程。 “提议器”和“编码器”会分别使用各自的奖励进行依次更新。 这种协同进化过程形成了一种自动化的课程学习机制，能够持续扩展模型生成更高正确性和性能内核的能力，同时减少所需的训练步数。

paragraphs.en: KernelZero is an end-to-end framework that formulates kernel generation as the co-evolution of two models with explicitly defined interfaces: a Proposer P P and a Coder C C . The Proposer takes a set of Torch APIs a ∈ 𝒜 a\in\mathcal{A} as input, and generates a compositional Torch module m ∼ π P ( ⋅ ∣ a ; θ P ) , m ∈ ℳ , m\sim\pi_{P}(\cdot\mid a;\theta_{P}),m\in\mathcal{M}, where ℳ \mathcal{M} denotes the space of valid and runnable Torch modules. The generated module m m defines a structured computation graph that serves as a high-level specification. Given a module m m , the Coder subsequently produces a corresponding CUDA or Triton kernel k ∼ π C ( ⋅ ∣ m ; θ C ) , k ∈ 𝒦 , k\sim\pi_{C}(\cdot\mid m;\theta_{C}),k\in\mathcal{K}, where 𝒦 \mathcal{K} is the space of executable kernels. The kernel k k is required to be functionally correct with respect to m m and optimized for hardware efficiency. This establishes a two-stage mapping a → 𝑃 m → 𝐶 k , a\xrightarrow{P}m\xrightarrow{C}k, where P P explores the space of operator compositions and C C realizes them as efficient low-level implementations.

paragraphs.en: The goal of the Proposer is to explore the space of operator compositions and generate high-quality modules at the frontier of the Coder’s capability, thereby progressively expanding the Coder’s skill boundary through targeted challenges. To achieve this goal, the modules generated from the Proposer should be expressive, reliable and frontier-oriented. Thus, the Proposer applies API-list sampling before module generation to encourage realistic and diverse operator combinations, followed by validation checks for correctness and usability. We also introduce a carefully designed Frontier Reward for the Proposer.
paragraphs.zh: 提案者的目标是探索算子组合的空间，在编码者能力的前沿生成高质量模块，从而通过有针对性的挑战逐步拓展编码者的技能边界。 为实现这一目标，由提案者生成的模块应具备表现力、可靠性和前沿导向性。 因此，提案者在模块生成前会应用 API 列表采样，以鼓励生成真实且多样化的算子组合，随后进行正确性和可用性的验证检查。 我们还为提案者引入了一套精心设计的“前沿奖励”机制。

paragraphs.en: The generated modules should also be reliable, meaning that each module satisfies strict correctness and usability constraints: it must be functionally valid, executable without runtime errors, and numerically stable. Thus, each proposed module is subjected to a multi-stage validation procedure to ensure its correctness and usability, including the following three stages. (1) AST Check. We first perform static analysis using an abstract syntax tree (AST) checker to verify semantic consistency, i.e., that the computation graph defined in the generated module matches the sampled API set a a . (2) Runnable Check. We then validate whether the module is executable. Specifically, each generated module includes two auxiliary methods, get_init_inputs and get_inputs , following the format of KernelBench [ 20 ] , where the former initializes input tensors with appropriate shapes and types, while the latter produces randomized inputs for testing. We invoke the get_init_inputs and get_inputs methods to construct valid inputs and execute the module on a CUDA device. Modules that fail to compile or raise runtime errors are discarded. (3) Numerical Stability. Finally, we evaluate the numerical stability of the module by running it on randomized inputs. Any sample that produces invalid values such as NaN or Inf is filtered out. Only modules that pass all three validation steps are considered valid. This validation pipeline ensures that the Proposer generates semantically consistent, executable, and numerically stable modules, enabling reliable training of the Coder.

paragraphs.en: The Coder aims to translate a Torch module into a CUDA or Triton kernel that serves as a low-level implementation of the input Torch module. The generated kernel is required to satisfy functional correctness while achieving high speedup over the corresponding Torch module. To this end, we propose a correctness-aware reward to balance correctness and performance. Kernel implementation also requires substantial domain-specific knowledge. Before reinforcement learning, we therefore introduce compiler-inspired cold-start distillation to equip the Coder with optimization principles from the earliest stage.

sents.zh: 因此，在强化学习之前，我们引入了一种受编译器启发的冷启动蒸馏方法，以便在初始阶段就让 Coder 掌握优化原则。

paragraphs.en: Modern GPU compilers and expert programmers typically rely on a set of fundamental optimization principles to transform a naive algorithm into a complex, high-performance GPU kernel implementation. Embedding these compiler-inspired principles during cold-start distillation helps the Coder internalize optimization patterns and benefits subsequent reinforcement learning. In this way, we summarize some optimization principles that are essential for bridging the gap between high-level operator specifications and low-level hardware efficiency. We utilize these principles to prompt a teacher model to reason about and apply optimization strategies during CUDA and Triton kernel distillation.
paragraphs.zh: 现代 GPU 编译器和专家程序员通常依赖一系列基本的优化原则，将简单的算法转化为复杂且高性能的 GPU 内核实现。 在冷启动蒸馏过程中嵌入这些受编译器启发的原则，有助于 Coder 内化优化模式，并促进后续的强化学习。 通过这种方式，我们总结了一些对于弥合高级算子规范与底层硬件效率之间差距至关重要的优化原则。 我们利用这些原则来引导教师模型在 CUDA 和 Triton 内核蒸馏过程中进行推理并应用优化策略。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we summarize four optimization principles that are both fundamental and complementary in GPU kernel design [ 28 , 27 ] :
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们总结了 GPU 内核设计中既基础又互补的四大优化原则 [ 28 , 27 ] :

paragraphs.en: Tiling partitions input tensors into block-level and warp-level tiles that fit on-chip memory, improving data reuse and reducing expensive global-memory access; it also enables efficient block/warp reductions for collective operators [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 平铺将输入张量划分为适合片上存储的块级和 warp 级瓦片，从而提升数据重用率并减少昂贵的全局内存访问；它还为集体算子实现了高效的块/warp 规约操作 [ 7 ]。

paragraphs.en: Fusion merges producer–consumer operator chains into a single kernel so intermediate tensors stay in registers or shared memory, reducing kernel-launch overhead, DRAM traffic, and synchronization cost [ 21 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 融合将生产者-消费者算子链合并为单个内核，使中间张量保留在寄存器或共享内存中，从而减少内核启动开销、DRAM 流量和同步成本 [ 21 ]。

paragraphs.en: Pipeline organizes computation into staged execution that overlaps memory movement (e.g., global-to-shared prefetch) with arithmetic, thereby hiding memory latency and increasing sustained SM utilization [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 流水线将计算组织为分阶段执行，使内存移动（例如，全局到共享内存的预取）与算术运算重叠，从而隐藏内存延迟并提高持续 SM 利用率 [ 22 ]。

paragraphs.en: Reordering rearranges loop/order-of-operations and thread/data mapping to improve coalesced access and temporal reuse, which strengthens cache/shared-memory locality and alleviates bank conflicts and divergence [ 1 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 重排序会重新安排循环/操作顺序以及线程/数据映射，以改善合并访问和时间复用性，从而增强缓存/共享内存的局部性，并缓解银行冲突和分歧 [ 1 ]。

paragraphs.en: These principles provide a structured taxonomy for reasoning about kernel efficiency, covering data reuse, memory latency hiding, execution overlap, and access pattern optimization. Each principle addresses a distinct bottleneck in the GPU memory hierarchy and execution model. By embedding these four optimization principles into the cold start training set, the Coder adheres to established GPU optimization heuristics.
paragraphs.zh: 这些原则为推理内核效率提供了一套结构化的分类体系，涵盖了数据重用、内存延迟隐藏、执行重叠和访问模式优化。 每一项原则都针对 GPU 内存层次结构和执行模型中的特定瓶颈。 通过将这四个优化原则嵌入到冷启动训练集中，Coder 遵循了既定的 GPU 优化启发式方法。

paragraphs.en: Kernel generation involves a fundamental trade-off between correctness and performance. Optimizing only for correctness often leads to conservative implementations with limited speedup. In contrast, focusing excessively on performance can break functional equivalence. This trade-off makes direct reward design unstable, especially in early training. To address this issue, we propose Correctness-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (CA-GRPO) to separate correctness and performance signals through a group-level mechanism, so that performance optimization is activated only when correctness becomes sufficiently reliable.
paragraphs.zh: 内核生成涉及正确性与性能之间的基本权衡。 仅针对正确性进行优化，通常会带来保守的实现方式，且加速效果有限。 相比之下，过度关注性能则可能破坏功能等价性。 这种权衡使得直接的奖励设计变得不稳定，尤其是在训练初期。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了“正确性感知组相对策略优化”（CA-GRPO），通过组级机制将正确性与性能信号分离，从而仅在正确性足够可靠时激活性能优化。

paragraphs.en: Before reinforcement learning, the Coder undergoes a cold start distillation phase. We start from the 71,996 kernel instances publicly released by cudaLLM [ 3 ] and re-sample each instance using gpt-oss-120B [ 19 ] as a teacher model. The teacher is prompted with the four GPU optimization principles described in Section 2.3 (Tiling, Fusion, Pipeline, Reordering) to produce step-by-step chain-of-thought reasoning before writing the final CUDA or Triton kernel. Each generated kernel is then verified for functional correctness, and only correct samples are retained. This filtering yields 42,454 CUDA traces and 59,998 Triton traces, on which the corresponding Coder is fine-tuned via supervised learning to internalize both the optimization logic and structured reasoning from the earliest stage.
paragraphs.zh: 在强化学习之前，Coder 会经历一个冷启动蒸馏阶段。 我们从 cudaLLM [ 3 ] 公开发布的 71,996 个内核实例开始，并使用 gpt-oss-120B [ 19 ] 作为教师模型对每个实例进行重新采样。 教师模型会接收到第 2.3 节中描述的四个 GPU 优化原则（分片、融合、管道、重排序）的提示，从而在编写最终的 CUDA 或 Triton 内核之前生成逐步的思维链推理过程。 随后，每个生成的内核都会被验证其功能正确性，并且只有正确的样本会被保留下来。 通过这一筛选过程，我们获得了 42,454 条 CUDA 轨迹和 59,998 条 Triton 轨迹，并基于这些轨迹对相应的 Coder 进行监督学习微调，使其从最初阶段就内化优化逻辑和结构化推理。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 further compares the performance profiles of Triton and CUDA generation. KernelZero achieves 43.9 fast 1 @1 and 87 fast 1 @10 with Triton on Level 1, compared with 17.6 and 29 with CUDA. The difference is larger on Level 2, where Triton reaches 65.4 fast 1 @1 and 96 fast 1 @10, while CUDA reaches 2.4 and 12. This gap reflects the optimization setting of the two backends. Triton provides tile-level programming abstractions and compiler-managed lowering, which make common tiling and fusion patterns easier to express. In contrast, our generated CUDA kernels do not call external high-performance libraries. Many Level-2 tasks contain convolutions or GEMMs, while their PyTorch references directly dispatch to highly optimized cuDNN or cuBLAS kernels. Standalone generated CUDA kernels therefore face a much stronger baseline and rarely surpass PyTorch without library calls. The low Level-2 fast 2 results for both backends further show that achieving a large speedup over these vendor-library-backed operators remains difficult.

paragraphs.en: GPU kernel generation from high-level specifications such as PyTorch modules has attracted growing attention [ 20 , 25 ] . Benchmark efforts evaluate LLM-generated kernels on correctness and runtime performance [ 20 , 15 ] , revealing significant gaps that motivate further training research. On the training side, supervised fine-tuning on curated kernel corpora has shown promise but requires substantial compute [ 3 , 10 , 14 ] , and trained models cannot be continuously improved without repeating the full pipeline. Reinforcement learning approaches use execution feedback to optimize for correctness or speedup [ 17 , 6 , 16 ] , but typically treat correctness and performance as a single undifferentiated reward. Search-based and agent-based methods improve kernel quality at inference time through iterative refinement [ 5 , 24 , 9 ] , but significantly increase inference costs.
paragraphs.zh: 基于 PyTorch 模块等高级规格生成 GPU 内核的做法日益受到关注 [ 20 , 25 ] 。 基准测试工作通过评估 LLM 生成的内核在正确性和运行时性能方面的表现 [ 20 , 15 ] ，揭示了其中的显著差距，从而推动了进一步的训练研究。 在训练方面，基于精选内核语料库的监督微调虽展现出潜力，但需要大量计算资源 [ 3 , 10 , 14 ] ，且未经重复完整流程便无法持续改进已训练的模型。 强化学习方法利用执行反馈来优化正确性或加速性能 [ 17 , 6 , 16 ] ，但通常将正确性和性能视为一个未加区分的单一奖励。 基于搜索和智能体的方法通过迭代优化提升推理阶段内核的质量 [ 5 , 24 , 9 ] ，但会显著增加推理成本。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we presented KernelZero, a framework that co-evolves a Proposer and a Coder for continuous GPU kernel generation. The Proposer generates frontier Torch modules according to the current capability of the Coder, while the Coder learns to produce correct and efficient CUDA or Triton kernels with CA-GRPO. The alternating training process forms an automatic curriculum without requiring manually constructed tasks at each stage. Experiments on KernelBench show that KernelZero-7B achieves 75.8% and 69.6% pass@1 for CUDA generation on Level 1 and 2, and 77.2% and 72.5% for Triton generation. These results demonstrate that capability-aligned data generation and correctness-aware optimization can improve both execution accuracy and kernel performance across different programming backends.
paragraphs.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出了 KernelZero——一个框架，它通过协同演化“提案者”和“编码者”来实现持续性的 GPU 内核生成。 “提案者”根据“编码者”当前的能力生成前沿的 Torch 模块，而“编码者”则借助 CA-GRPO 学习生成正确且高效的 CUDA 或 Triton 内核。 这种交替训练过程能够形成自动化的课程规划，无需在每个阶段都依赖人工构建的任务。 在 KernelBench 上的实验表明，KernelZero-7B 在 CUDA 生成的 Level 1 和 Level 2 任务上分别达到了 75.8% 和 69.6% 的 pass@1 准确率，而在 Triton 生成任务上则分别达到了 77.2% 和 72.5%。 这些结果表明，与能力对齐的数据生成以及注重正确性的优化方法，能够提升不同编程后端在执行准确率和内核性能方面的表现。

paragraphs.en: We found two issues with the original KernelBench evaluation. First, running multiple programs on the same GPU can cause interference between programs or insufficient memory, making both correctness and latency measurements unreliable. Second, some operators randomly initialize parameters in their __init__ methods. KernelBench attempts to construct identical parameters using a fixed random seed. However, this method is insufficient when the reference and generated implementations invoke random operations in different orders.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在原始 KernelBench 评估中发现了两个问题。 首先，在同一个 GPU 上运行多个程序可能会导致程序间相互干扰或内存不足，从而使正确性和延迟的测量结果都不可靠。 其次，某些算子会在其 __init__ 方法中随机初始化参数。 KernelBench 试图使用固定的随机种子来构造相同的参数。 然而，当参考实现和生成的实现以不同顺序调用随机操作时，这种方法并不充分。

sents.en: We found two issues with the original KernelBench evaluation.
sents.zh: 我们在原始 KernelBench 评估中发现了两个问题。

sents.en: First, running multiple programs on the same GPU can cause interference between programs or insufficient memory, making both correctness and latency measurements unreliable.
sents.zh: 首先，在同一个 GPU 上运行多个程序可能会导致程序间相互干扰或内存不足，从而使正确性和延迟的测量结果都不可靠。

sents.en: Second, some operators randomly initialize parameters in their __init__ methods.
sents.zh: 其次，某些算子会在其 __init__ 方法中随机初始化参数。

sents.en: KernelBench attempts to construct identical parameters using a fixed random seed.
sents.zh: KernelBench 试图使用固定的随机种子来构造相同的参数。

sents.en: However, this method is insufficient when the reference and generated implementations invoke random operations in different orders.
sents.zh: 然而，当参考实现和生成的实现以不同顺序调用随机操作时，这种方法并不充分。

paragraphs.en: To address these issues, we developed Keck (Kernel Check) based on cudaLLM 1 1 1 https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/cudaLLM . Keck provides a unified validation interface for both CUDA and Triton implementations. It isolates candidate programs during execution and overlaps the processing of different requests to improve evaluation throughput. As shown in Figure 6 , Keck has the following features.
paragraphs.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们基于 cudaLLM 开发了 Keck（Kernel Check）1 1 1 https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/cudaLLM 。 Keck 为 CUDA 和 Triton 两种实现提供了统一的验证接口。 它在执行期间隔离候选程序，并重叠处理不同请求，以提高评估吞吐量。 如图 6 所示，Keck 具有以下功能。

sents.en: To address these issues, we developed Keck (Kernel Check) based on cudaLLM 1 1 1 https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/cudaLLM .
sents.zh: 为解决这些问题，我们基于 cudaLLM 开发了 Keck（Kernel Check）1 1 1 https://github.com/ByteDance-Seed/cudaLLM 。

sents.en: Keck provides a unified validation interface for both CUDA and Triton implementations.
sents.zh: Keck 为 CUDA 和 Triton 两种实现提供了统一的验证接口。

sents.en: It isolates candidate programs during execution and overlaps the processing of different requests to improve evaluation throughput.
sents.zh: 它在执行期间隔离候选程序，并重叠处理不同请求，以提高评估吞吐量。

sents.en: As shown in Figure 6 , Keck has the following features.
sents.zh: 如图 6 所示，Keck 具有以下功能。

paragraphs.en: Backend-aware compilation and execution. CUDA extensions are compiled in parallel by CPU workers. Once compilation finishes, the resulting extension is immediately dispatched to an available GPU worker. Triton programs do not require a separate CUDA extension compilation stage. They are JIT-compiled when first invoked on the assigned GPU. The warm-up executions complete Triton compilation before latency is measured.
paragraphs.zh: 后端感知编译与执行。 CUDA 扩展由 CPU 工作线程并行编译。 编译完成后，生成的扩展会立即分发到可用的 GPU 工作线程。 Triton 程序无需单独的 CUDA 扩展编译阶段。 它们在首次于指定 GPU 上调用时进行 JIT 编译。 预热执行会在测量延迟前完成 Triton 的编译。

sents.en: Backend-aware compilation and execution.
sents.zh: 后端感知编译与执行。

sents.en: CUDA extensions are compiled in parallel by CPU workers.
sents.zh: CUDA 扩展由 CPU 工作线程并行编译。

sents.en: Once compilation finishes, the resulting extension is immediately dispatched to an available GPU worker.
sents.zh: 编译完成后，生成的扩展会立即分发到可用的 GPU 工作线程。

sents.en: Triton programs do not require a separate CUDA extension compilation stage.
sents.zh: Triton 程序无需单独的 CUDA 扩展编译阶段。

sents.en: They are JIT-compiled when first invoked on the assigned GPU.
sents.zh: 它们在首次于指定 GPU 上调用时进行 JIT 编译。

sents.en: The warm-up executions complete Triton compilation before latency is measured.
sents.zh: 预热执行会在测量延迟前完成 Triton 的编译。

paragraphs.en: Single-sample GPU execution. Each GPU worker executes only one candidate program at a time. This prevents memory and execution interference between samples and provides a consistent environment for correctness validation and latency measurement. Each candidate is executed in a separate process, which is terminated after the evaluation finishes or exceeds the time limit.
paragraphs.zh: 单样本 GPU 执行。 每个 GPU 工作者每次仅执行一个候选程序。 这能防止样本之间的内存和执行干扰，并为正确性验证和延迟测量提供一致的环境。 每个候选程序都在独立进程中执行，评估结束后或超过时间限制后，该进程将被终止。

sents.en: Single-sample GPU execution.
sents.zh: 单样本 GPU 执行。

sents.en: Each GPU worker executes only one candidate program at a time.
sents.zh: 每个 GPU 工作者每次仅执行一个候选程序。

sents.en: This prevents memory and execution interference between samples and provides a consistent environment for correctness validation and latency measurement.
sents.zh: 这能防止样本之间的内存和执行干扰，并为正确性验证和延迟测量提供一致的环境。

sents.en: Each candidate is executed in a separate process, which is terminated after the evaluation finishes or exceeds the time limit.
sents.zh: 每个候选程序都在独立进程中执行，评估结束后或超过时间限制后，该进程将被终止。

paragraphs.en: Module parameter consistency. Keck first constructs the PyTorch reference model and the generated model using the same random seed. When the two implementations have compatible parameters, it additionally transfers the reference state_dict to the generated CUDA or Triton model through load_state_dict . This ensures that correctness is evaluated using identical parameter values rather than relying only on identical random seeds. This is particularly important for operators whose initialization behavior depends on the construction order 2 2 2 https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench/issues/88 .
paragraphs.zh: 模块参数一致性。 Keck 首先使用相同的随机种子构建 PyTorch 参考模型和生成的模型。 当两种实现的参数兼容时，它还会通过 load_state_dict 将参考模型的 state_dict 传输到生成的 CUDA 或 Triton 模型中。 这确保了正确性评估是基于完全相同的参数值，而不仅仅是依赖相同的随机种子。 对于初始化行为依赖于构建顺序的算子而言，这一点尤为重要 2 2 2 https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench/issues/88 。

sents.en: Module parameter consistency.
sents.zh: 模块参数一致性。

sents.en: Keck first constructs the PyTorch reference model and the generated model using the same random seed.
sents.zh: Keck 首先使用相同的随机种子构建 PyTorch 参考模型和生成的模型。

sents.en: When the two implementations have compatible parameters, it additionally transfers the reference state_dict to the generated CUDA or Triton model through load_state_dict .
sents.zh: 当两种实现的参数兼容时，它还会通过 load_state_dict 将参考模型的 state_dict 传输到生成的 CUDA 或 Triton 模型中。

sents.en: This ensures that correctness is evaluated using identical parameter values rather than relying only on identical random seeds.
sents.zh: 这确保了正确性评估是基于完全相同的参数值，而不仅仅是依赖相同的随机种子。

sents.en: This is particularly important for operators whose initialization behavior depends on the construction order 2 2 2 https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench/issues/88 .
sents.zh: 对于初始化行为依赖于构建顺序的算子而言，这一点尤为重要 2 2 2 https://github.com/ScalingIntelligence/KernelBench/issues/88 。

paragraphs.en: Unified numerical validation. The reference and generated implementations receive independent copies of the same inputs, preventing in-place operations from affecting subsequent executions. Their outputs are compared using both absolute and relative tolerances of 10 − 2 10^{-2} . Compilation errors, execution errors, timeouts, output-shape mismatches, and numerical mismatches are reported separately.
paragraphs.zh: 统一数值验证。 参考实现和生成的实现接收相同输入的独立副本，从而防止原地操作影响后续执行。 使用绝对容差和相对容差均为 10^{-2} 的方式比较它们的输出。 编译错误、执行错误、超时、输出形状不匹配以及数值不匹配将分别报告。

sents.en: Unified numerical validation.
sents.zh: 统一数值验证。

sents.en: The reference and generated implementations receive independent copies of the same inputs, preventing in-place operations from affecting subsequent executions.
sents.zh: 参考实现和生成的实现接收相同输入的独立副本，从而防止原地操作影响后续执行。

sents.en: Their outputs are compared using both absolute and relative tolerances of 10 − 2 10^{-2} .
sents.zh: 使用绝对容差和相对容差均为 10^{-2} 的方式比较它们的输出。

sents.en: Compilation errors, execution errors, timeouts, output-shape mismatches, and numerical mismatches are reported separately.
sents.zh: 编译错误、执行错误、超时、输出形状不匹配以及数值不匹配将分别报告。

paragraphs.en: Backend-specific implementation constraints. For CUDA generation, the target computation must be implemented using native CUDA kernels rather than delegated to PyTorch computational APIs. For Triton generation, the target computation must be performed by actual @triton.jit kernels. Python and PyTorch may be used for module construction and tensor allocation, but not as a replacement for the kernel computation being evaluated. These constraints prevent models from obtaining high scores by retaining the original PyTorch implementation.
paragraphs.zh: 后端特定的实现限制。 对于 CUDA 生成，目标计算必须使用原生 CUDA 内核来实现，而不能委托给 PyTorch 的计算 API。 对于 Triton 生成，目标计算必须由实际的 @triton.jit 内核执行。 Python 和 PyTorch 可用于模块构建和张量分配，但不能用来替代正在评估的内核计算。 这些限制防止了模型通过保留原始的 PyTorch 实现来获得高分。

sents.zh: 后端特定的实现限制。

sents.en: For CUDA generation, the target computation must be implemented using native CUDA kernels rather than delegated to PyTorch computational APIs.
sents.zh: 对于 CUDA 生成，目标计算必须使用原生 CUDA 内核来实现，而不能委托给 PyTorch 的计算 API。

sents.en: For Triton generation, the target computation must be performed by actual @triton.jit kernels.

paragraphs.en: Correctness-gated performance measurement. Performance is measured only after the generated implementation passes the numerical correctness check. paragraphs.en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is an on-policy reinforcement learning algorithm built upon the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) framework. GRPO removes the value model to significantly reduce inference cost, while introducing group relative advantage estimation to more accurately assess the quality of model outputs. Furthermore, a KL-divergence penalty is incorporated to stabilize policy updates and prevent the policy from deviating excessively against the reference model.
paragraphs.zh: 群体相对策略优化（GRPO）是一种基于近端策略优化（PPO）框架的在线策略强化学习算法。 GRPO 移除了价值模型，从而显著降低了推理成本，同时引入了群体相对优势估计，以更准确地评估模型输出的质量。 此外，该算法还加入了 KL 散度惩罚项，以稳定策略更新，并防止策略与参考模型发生过度偏离。

paragraphs.en: All optimization jobs are conducted on NVIDIA A100 GPUs with 80 GB of memory. Each Proposer or Coder optimization job uses four A100-80GB GPUs on one node. During a Proposer update, the fixed Coder and Keck are deployed as two independent services, each using another four A100-80GB GPUs. Thus, a Proposer update occupies 12 GPUs in total, including the optimization, Coder inference, and execution-validation services. During a Coder update, Keck runs as a separate four-GPU service, resulting in eight GPUs in total. Based on the recorded runs, a 20-step Proposer update takes approximately 3.1 hours, while a 20-step Coder update takes approximately 4.5 hours. These measurements include rollout generation, nested Coder inference, execution validation, and policy updates.
paragraphs.zh: 所有优化任务均在配备 80 GB 内存的 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上执行。 每个 Proposer 或 Coder 优化任务都在单个节点上使用四块 A100-80GB GPU。 在 Proposer 更新期间，固定的 Coder 和 Keck 被部署为两个独立服务，每个服务使用另外四块 A100-80GB GPU。 因此，一次 Proposer 更新总共占用 12 块 GPU，包括优化、Coder 推理和执行验证服务。 在 Coder 更新期间，Keck 作为一个独立的四 GPU 服务运行，总共需要八块 GPU。 根据记录的运行数据，一次 20 步的 Proposer 更新大约需要 3.1 小时，而一次 20 步的 Coder 更新大约需要 4.5 小时。 这些测量值包括部署生成、嵌套 Coder 推理、执行验证和策略更新。
